P.name: Hemorrhage
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Darius' ''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Hemorrhage'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Hemorrhage:}} For each stack, the target is dealt{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|13 to 30}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} over the duration,|{{as|{{pplevel|3.25 to 7.5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|1.25}} seconds over the duration,}}up to a maximum of{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|13*5 to 30*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} over the duration.|{{as|{{pplevel|3.25*5 to 7.5*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each tick.}}''Hemorrhage'' deals 250% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description3: When '''Darius''' kills a champion with ''{{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}}'', or applies 5 stacks on an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he becomes empowered with ''Noxian Might'' for 5 seconds.
P.description4: {{sbc|Noxian Might:}} '''Darius''' gains {{pplevel|30; then +5*x for 9; then +10*x for 3; then +25*x|formula=30 + 5 per level until level 10, then + 10 per level until level 13, then + 25 per level|color=AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and instantly applies 5 ''Hemorrhage'' stacks through his usual means.
P.spelleffects: proc <!--used to say default, undocumented change?-->

Q.name: Decimate
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} for 1 second and hefts his axe for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, afterward swinging it around himself to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage (Blade)|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100 to 140}}% AD)}}|Reduced Damage (Handle)|{{ap|50*0.35 to 170*0.35}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.35 to 140*0.35}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description2: Against champions and large monsters hit, '''Darius''' {{tip|heal|heals}} for {{as|{{sti|health|{{pp|changedisplay=true|type=number of targets hit by the outer radius|key=%|17 to 51 for 3|1;2;3+|formula=17% * number of targets hit. ''This is capped at 3 enemies.''}} of his '''missing''' health}}}}. Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of ''{{ai|Hemorrhage|Darius}}''.
Q.description3: '''''Darius''' can move during Decimate, but is unable to declare basic attacks or cast {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}}.''

W.name: Crippling Strike
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 90% for 1 second. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
W.description2: If this attack kills the target, half of ''Crippling Strike's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
W.description3: ''Crippling Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Darius' ''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Apprehend
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' sweeps his axe in a cone in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second while {{tip|airborne|pulling}} enemies hit towards him. Upon arrival, they rebound {{tt|150|Estimated}} units off of him, remaining {{tip|airborne}} and becoming {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% for 1 second.
E.description3: '''''Darius''' is unable to move or cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Apprehend's cast time.''

R.name: Noxian Guillotine
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Darius''' attempts to execute the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|lunge|leaping}} towards them to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}, increased by {{pp|type=target's [[File:Hemorrhage.png|20px]] Hemorrhage stacks|key=%|0 to 100 by 20|0 to 5|formula=20% for every Hemorrhage stack the target has, capped at 100% at 5 stacks}}, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds from the start of the cast time.
R.leveling: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|125 to 375}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|125*0.2 to 375*0.2}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum True Damage|{{ap|125*2 to 375*2}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description2: If the target dies within {{fd|0.15}} seconds after being hit by ''Noxian Guillotine'', '''Darius''' {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration. He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.
R.description3: At rank 3, ''Noxian Guillotine'' has no {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and recast timer.
R.description4: '''''Darius''' is unable to cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Apprehend|Darius}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Noxian Guillotine's cast time.''
